conditions.note: Title complaint "skin lump/s"; Mass of skin (vocabulary term) is the general skin lump finding.
Lumps beneath the skin (cyst/lipoma branch) are not descendants of Mass of skin in SNOMED, so the trigger also accepts Mass of subcutaneous tissue.
"Mole" encoded as Pigmented skin lesion (vocabulary term; parent of Melanocytic nevus and of the pigmented-lesion change concepts used below).
No "painful lump" concept; Pain of skin as a separate finding.
Firm lump: Mass of skin with Firm qualifier.
Red lump: Redness of skin over lesion.
Warm lump: Warm skin (vocabulary term); no lesion-specific concept.
Softening in the centre read as fluctuance.
No active finding concept for pus discharging from skin (Purulent discharge exists only as substance/morphology); Skin discharge used, so any discharge counts.
